title: objectql update: when every caller-supplied field is dropped (readonly / readonlyWhen), the row is still stamped and afterUpdate still runs (split from #34701)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: split from #34701 by its card thread's premise reading on `origin/main` `f6f5b50a` (half B; measured in the objectql engine with a capturing in-memory driver). Dedupe: `all fields dropped update no-op`; no open card.

Suggested-grade: p1 (inherits #34701) · domain:server · Blocked-by #34672

## 维护者速读

- 现象：一次更新里调用方给的字段如果全部被丢弃(只读字段、readonlyWhen 锁住的字段),引擎仍然写这一行：盖上最后修改人和时间，并照跑 afterUpdate 钩子，「更新时」的流程和触发器会把它当成一次真的更新。
- 为什么要修：什么都没改，记录头却显示「刚被某人修改」,自动化也被白白触发。
- 需要你做的：无(分诊定级)。

## Readings

| Request | `driver.update` receives | dropped | afterUpdate |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{total_score: 100}` (readonly) | `{updated_at, updated_by}` | readonly | runs |
| `{locked_note: 'x'}` (readonlyWhen-locked) | `{updated_at, updated_by}` | readonly_when | runs |

`packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts` has no short-circuit between the strip and `driver.update` (by-id and predicate branches alike). No audit row is written (the audit diff skips the stamp columns), so the card's "history" is the record header's last-modified fields.

## Change (seat's reading, inside the maintainer's veto window)

When the strip removes every caller-supplied key, the update is a no-op: no driver write, no stamps, **afterUpdate does not run**, and the answer is the current record plus `droppedFields` (the REST header as today). Both branches. A same-value write (nothing dropped) is out of scope and unchanged. Strict mode already refuses a dropped key and is unchanged. This narrows when "on update" automation fires ⇒ L1 + L2 + Tier H.

## Done when

Pins for both branches show no driver write and no afterUpdate when every key is dropped, and an unchanged path when at least one key survives.
